description: USB micro-B receptacle, 5-pin SMD with through-hole shield tabs. Standard USB 2.0 device-side connector for embedded boards. 5-pin includes ID pin for OTG host/device detection.
name: usb-micro-b-receptacle-5p
watch_out_for: Pin 4 (ID): float = B-device, grounded = OTG A-device. Shield tabs need solid GND pour. Micro-USB is mechanically weaker than USB-C. ESD protection on D+/D- strongly recommended. 5-pin micro-B, not micro-A (visually similar but incompatible).
